claim: Agentic LLM router on leaf-classification made an INFORMED decision — coder+aggregator=opus (image classification needs CV depth, ensemble step needs CV depth), other 7 roles=sonnet (mid-cost). This MATCHES E022 X215's successful routing ($12 valid sub, medal=none). The agent demonstrably READ memory/routing/evidence/E022 and reused the pattern. HOWEVER the run failed because designer (sonnet) hit the 15min wall-clock budget + 10min grace and timed out at +0:29:33 — Pipeline failed before any node was attempted. Total $2.76 burned (setup $0.73, splitter $0.32, designer $1.70). This is a sonnet-designer timeout regression, NOT a routing-logic failure — the LLM router would have likely succeeded had the designer's wall-clock budget been bigger or had it been on opus. E022 X215 used sonnet designer too at this budget without timeout — variance.

support.interpretation: EXACT MATCH for E022 X215's coder+aggregator=opus, rest=sonnet. The LLM router successfully read evidence/E022 and reused the known-good routing pattern — this is the §9 agentic raw-memory-reader working as designed.

failure.elapsed: 29:33 from pipeline start; designer alone consumed ~22min of wall-clock

scope: Single Phase 2 run. The routing decision is the headline finding; the timeout is an unrelated infrastructure variance.
limitations: Sonnet designer on leaf can hit the 15min budget (P7 wall-clock concern). E022 X215 succeeded with sonnet designer — this run did not. Variance unexplained.
Cannot tell if the LLM router would have produced gold given a successful designer.
confidence: high (routing decision validation) / low (success-on-this-run, since pipeline aborted at designer)

implications.agentic_router_finding_confirmed: Combined with E029 (nomad2018 router picked task-appropriate mixed routing), the agentic LLM router has now demonstrated competent reading of memory + family default + per-task evidence on TWO tasks. It picked the right thing on leaf (matching X215) without being told.
implications.next_experiment_design: Switch to DENOISING (E025 X205 baseline opus-all gold $10.59). Denoising pipeline budget is 60min so designer timeout is less likely. Test: does the LLM router pick opus-all (matching family memory's denoising entry) or downgrade? If downgrade succeeds at lower cost, the router has discovered something new.

next_actions: Launch E-PN4-denoising: same router config (router_strategy=llm, per_node_routing=false). Denoising 60min budget, n=2 family baseline opus-all gold $10.59.
If E-PN4-denoising also fails with timeout, the leaf failure was infrastructure-wide not leaf-specific.
